Here we have some explanation – which is not found in the thesis – regarding the sense of hearing and the interaction between external air and internal air, that is the air inside the ear. This is in fact the source of thesis 9 which determines that the organ of hearing is a nerve expanded towards the hollow space of the ear.53 According to Albert air is naturally held in the ear, in its inner part which is called tympanum, the audible nerve. This nerve is expanded in the inner ear,
